description: Ask Amazon whether this seller account may list a brand: allowed, approval_required (with the link to apply), not_eligible, or unknown. Amazon answers such questions per ASIN only (Listings Restrictions API) — there is no account-level brand query — so the answer is read for a SAMPLE ASIN of the brand: the one you pass, else the first catalog match whose brand equals the name. The result names the sampleAsin it was read for; when no item of the brand is found the status is unknown. Amazon has no 'application pending' state: until Amazon approves, the status stays approval_required. Reads Amazon, never writes. Use search_amazon_catalog to pick a sample ASIN, and check_amazon_readiness for a product.

brand.description: The brand name as Amazon shows it, e.g. 'DEMI Design Milano'.

marketplaceId.description: One Amazon store by its id (APJ6JRA9NG5V4 is amazon.it, A1PA6795UKMFR9 is amazon.de). Omit for the main store.

sampleAsin.description: An ASIN of the brand on this store, when you already have one (from search_amazon_catalog).

name: check_amazon_brand_access
title: Check Amazon brand access
